name: Orange Lionfish 62
author: KhelVers
description: Rounded blue button that responds while pressed down.
howItWorks: While pressed, top becomes 8px, border becomes 6px solid #646fff, box-shadow becomes 0px 0px.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Orange Lionfish 62</title>
<style>
/* Orange Lionfish 62 by KhelVers — https://uiverse.io/KhelVers/orange-lionfish-62 */
.button {
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: large;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: #0011ff;
  background-color: #f8f8fd;
  padding: 0.8em 2.2em;
  border-radius: 50em;
  border: 6px solid #8b93f8;
  box-shadow: 0px 8px #1f35ff;
}
.button:active {
  position: relative;
  top: 8px;
  border: 6px solid #646fff;
  box-shadow: 0px 0px;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="button">Winter</button>
